title: 171 or 173 North Main
what_we_know: Plate 13's caption gives 171 North Main Street. The post's text, the 1957 incorporation notice (plate 18) and the 1958 revocation (plate 24) give 173.
what_we_dont: Whether 171 is a slip, another number for the same building, or a second address.
what_might_answer_it: Sanborn fire-insurance maps of Sheridan; city directories; county property records.
evidence_needed: A map or property record giving the building's number or numbers.
